description: Priority plant threshold rules for in-process CEP (EventRuleEngine). Non-threshold types are declared but deferred — engine only evaluates condition.type == threshold. Fired threshold rules persist durable alerts via AlertService.

rules.name: Temperature Critical Threshold
rules.description: DEFERRED: telemetry normalization does not emit temperature metrics. Fires when machine temperature exceeds 85°C

rules.name: Temperature Warning
rules.description: DEFERRED: telemetry normalization does not emit temperature metrics. Fires when machine temperature exceeds 70°C

rules.name: High Vibration Alert
rules.description: DEFERRED: telemetry normalization does not emit vibration metrics. Fires when vibration sensor reading exceeds 350 Hz

rules.name: Low Pressure Alert
rules.description: DEFERRED: telemetry normalization does not emit pressure metrics. Fires when pressure drops below 1.0 bar

rules.name: Multi-Machine Error Correlation
rules.description: DEFERRED: correlation evaluator not implemented in EventRuleEngine. Fires when 3+ machines on the same line report errors within 5 minutes

rules.name: Production Drop >20%
rules.description: DEFERRED: comparison evaluator not implemented in EventRuleEngine. Fires when hourly production drops more than 20% compared to same hour yesterday

rules.name: Low OEE Alert
rules.description: Fires when machine OEE drops below 65%

rules.name: Maintenance Overdue
rules.description: DEFERRED: runtime_threshold evaluator not implemented in EventRuleEngine. Fires when machine runtime exceeds maintenance interval (500 hours) without service record

rules.name: Yield Rate Critical Drop
rules.description: Fires when yield rate drops below 90%

rules.name: High CPU Usage
rules.description: DEFERRED: telemetry normalization does not emit cpu_percent metrics. Fires when machine controller CPU exceeds 90%
